title: TypeScript run natively, vitest in-process, Playwright for the page
context: The module and the page are small, and the criteria split into in-process rules and one browser-visible behaviour.
decision: Write TypeScript that Node runs with type stripping; test the rules with vitest and the page with @playwright/test against the pack's own server.
consequences: No build step; two runners, so one criterion is bound to tests in both.
